entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please say 'Support' or 'Sales' to be routed to the correct department.
SUPPORT!
Connecting you to a VeloFit support agent now.
Thank you for calling VeloFit, my name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
I need to return this piece of junk VeloBand I bought. It's useless.
I'm sorry to hear you're not satisfied with the product. I can certainly look into that for you. Could I get your name and order number, please?
The name is Mark Peterson, order number 8-6-7-5-3-0-9. Just process the return, I don't have time for a runaround.

Thank you, Mark. I'm pulling up your order now. To make sure I understand correctly and follow the right procedure, what specifically is the issue with the band? Is it a technical fault or a preference issue?
I'm not doing this! I don't like it, it doesn't work the way I thought, and I want my money back. This isn't a negotiation. Are you going to help me or do I need to speak to your manager?
I understand your frustration, and I can definitely check on the return eligibility. I see you received the VeloBand Cadence Sensor on December 21st, which was about 25 days ago.
Yeah, so what? Just get it done.

Well sir, I just need to check our current return guidelines. For wearable items, due to **hygiene** and potential bio-contaminants, the return **policy** can be quite strict. After a certain point, for **sanitation** reasons, it becomes **too late** to accept them back...
TOO LATE?! ARE YOU KIDDING ME?! Your website clearly says 90 days! I have a screenshot! This is a scam! I want to speak to a manager RIGHT NOW before I post this entire conversation online!

You are absolutely right, sir. My sincerest apologies. I was mistakenly looking at the specialized guidelines for our new biometric Pulse monitors. You purchased the VeloBand Cadence Sensor, and that falls under our standard 90-day return **policy**.
You are well within the 90-day window. I can and will process this return for a full refund for you immediately. I am very sorry for that confusion.
Oh. So... you're actually going to approve it then?

Yes, absolutely. I've just initiated the return in our system. I'm sending a prepaid shipping label to the email address on your account right now. Just place the device back in its original packaging, affix the label, and drop it at any post office.
Alright. Fine. That's all I wanted in the first place.

I completely understand. Once our warehouse receives the item, your refund will be issued to your original form of payment within 3 to 5 business days. Was there anything else I could help you with, Mark?
No, that's it.
Okay. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and again, my apologies for the mix-up. Have a good day.
